ideas.title: FBI Investigation into 2020 Election
ideas.description: This story would investigate the FBI's investigation into the 2020 election, including the recent search warrant at the Fulton County election hub.
questions: What is the scope of the FBI's investigation?
What evidence has been uncovered so far?
ideas.insight: This investigation has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing, including potential election fraud. I will continue to monitor this investigation and provide updates as necessary.

ideas.title: Federal Agent Misconduct
ideas.description: This story would investigate the recent incidents of federal agent misconduct, including the shooting of Alex Pretti in Minnesota.
questions: What are the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Alex Pretti?
What measures are being taken to address federal agent misconduct?
ideas.insight: These incidents raise concerns about the use of force by federal agents and the need for increased oversight and accountability. I will continue to monitor these incidents and provide updates as necessary.
